document: Supervisor v10 disposition: all nine v9 findings under the binding narrowed parent scope; written only
author: ContinueRQLS10b

findings.title: unresolved helper ownership discharged by reaping
findings.disposition: No metadata helper is spawned or supported in v10. No helper state machine exists. This is authorized by the v10 parent decision, not an assumption that v8's Python-rendered dates were accepted. v10 writes no human-readable timestamps. The parent alone reads /bin/date for GO/audit/release timestamps.

findings.title: helper overrun and exceptional cleanup
findings.disposition: No helper or helper call budget exists. v10 can spawn exactly one separately reviewed single-process child. Native threads are permitted, no fork/exec/subprocess/multiprocessing. The actual Python.app executable must be used instead of the Homebrew framework launcher (which re-execs).

findings.title: backdated clearance
findings.disposition: Supervisor.clearance verifies child reap, two error-free closed streams and ended sink threads BEFORE a fresh complete census. After that census it rechecks these monotone predicates and only then reads mono_all_predicates_verified, comparing that fresh time against every active grace cutoff. It does not use census.mono_complete as clearance time. Finalization cannot manufacture a missing timely-clear observation.

findings.title: incomplete identity brackets / real-or-effective uid
findings.disposition: identify brackets short-info reads with three uniqueid+idversion reads and compares pid, uniqueid, idversion, euid, ruid, ppid, pgid and trace flag. Current-parent ownership proofs bracket BOTH parent and child identities; measurements bracket the same full fingerprint. Same-user predicate is euid==MY_UID OR ruid==MY_UID. Cwd is read both before and after argv; all negatives must be readable and stable. Unreadability yields incomplete census, never an exemption. Child identity changes latch CHILD_IDENTITY_CHANGED.
findings.host_constraint: Read-only ps found four persistent login processes with ruid501/euid0. If their metadata is unreadable, strict v10 admission may be unavailable on this host. No permission exemption, zero-RSS fallback or effective-uid-only weakening is applied; the parent has been informed. A separate explicit policy decision would be needed to change that behavior.

supporting_source.fact: exec changes p_idversion, including a guarantee that it differs from the previous version (lines7096-7104)

findings.title: stale expiry/fit after I/O
findings.disposition: GO carries raw not_after_epoch and stability_receipt_sha256. authorization_io re-reads and binds exact GO and stability bytes at admission, launch preparation, GO preparation and acknowledgment preparation. No date-age extrapolation remains. time_commit uses fresh epoch/monotonic readings AFTER I/O, under protected cancellation masking, to check expiry and applicable remaining fit. Launch and GO also require a recent complete within-limit census (resource_age), fresh accounting and held reservations. At acknowledgment resources are recomputed after both publications and directory fsyncs.

findings.title: payload differs from budget / missing launch and tmp charges
findings.disposition: final_body builds the FINAL receipt rb and settlement sb once, then budgets exactly len(rb)+len(sb) and publishes those same bytes without mutation. Insufficient or unavailable budget refuses publication (exit12/13 with an unsuccessful summary), not publish-as-UNSETTLED. Run charge walks every output root (launch/samples/sinks/declared and stray outputs) plus retained TMPDIR. Walks count distinct(dev,ino) logical st_size, so settlement and .staged count once. Own unused reservation and all parent outstanding reservations remain held through acknowledgment; the supervisor releases none. The summary carries exact receipt/settlement sizes, publication_resources and ack_resources for independent arithmetic.

findings.title: accounting root unretained
findings.disposition: open_anchors retains lane-disk root fd/device/inode and reaches output roots and TMPDIR by no-follow component traversal beneath it. verify_anchors verifies path resolution still names the retained identities. walk_fd always starts from those retained descriptors, refuses volume boundaries, and errors rather than skipping disappeared/retyped charged directories. No walk adopts a replacement pathname root's device/inode.

findings.title: completion deadline gaps
findings.disposition: Deadline checks follow file opens/reads/closes, final writes, fsyncs, linked-publication readback, directory iterator exit/sort, every walk child/root close, fstatvfs, census completion/retries, sink fsync/file close/pipe close and samples fsync/close. Observation deadlines clamp to known grace/chunk cutoffs; final evidence gathering uses its own bounded phase after expiry and cannot restore timely clearance. Publication and acknowledgment completion checks are fail closed; an overrun after acknowledgment bytes were written returns14 so exit/summary cannot satisfy the parent's commit join.
findings.residual: Native calls cannot be interrupted. This is late-return detection, not a universal native-call latency guarantee.

findings.title: unprotected cancellation commits
findings.disposition: Cancellation signals are blocked on sink threads (inherited at creation); only the main thread receives them. protected masks SIGTERM/INT/HUP on the main thread, checking both the Python latch and sigpending at each commit. LAUNCH atomically commits authorization, then restores the mask BEFORE Popen (no inherited blocked SIGTERM); any cancellation after that authorization is a post-launch stop and prevents GO. GO write/flush/close occur while masked after fresh checks. ACK encoding/write/flush occur while masked after fresh checks. Signals arriving after these commits are ordered after them; a late cancel not already handled refuses ACK. Independent parent exit+summary+digest+ended-owned+late-artifact verification remains mandatory.
findings.boundary: The protected launch commit is authorization immediately before Popen, not a claim that OS process creation is atomic with signal delivery.

ownership_scope: Only the child plus every identity ever observed in its process group or with an observed owned current parent. Any extra identity latches SINGLE_PROCESS_CONTRACT_VIOLATION and retains the parent block until every such identity is verified ended. Unlinked same-uid processes are NOT blocking. A fast violating fork+setsid+intermediate exit can evade sampling; child source review is the mitigation. No speculative birth genealogy or OS-universal guarantee is claimed.

qualification_interface.qualification_only_threshold: busy_limit may be 0 for guard-qualification; one spinning child can exercise BUSY without forking and without relaxing global busy<=2; cpu_slots stays1

verification_boundary: AST parsing and static name checks only. No supervisor, child, helper, assay, test or qualification was executed. No GO requested or implied. The updated single-process qualification package is a separate source deliverable.
